fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the use of the "gcc" utility to execute a shell. Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or to break out from restricted environments.
fields.name: Shell Execution GCC  - Linux
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and (((tgt.process.image.path contains "/c89" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/c99" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/gcc") and tgt.process.cmdline contains "-wrapper") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "/bin/bash,-s" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/bin/dash,-s" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/bin/fish,-s" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/bin/sh,-s" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/bin/zsh,-s")))
